digest.component_or_area: git history reclaim and repository maintenance
propositions: A committed operational script must safely rewrite repository history using stock git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) to strip .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ directories while preserving commit and merge-commit topology.
The script must refuse execution on blob:none partial clones and provide operator-readable remediation requiring a fresh unfiltered clone.
The script must dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoding file names, to safely accommodate future .bridge_state/ extensions like get_rotation.json.
The script must parse fast-export data blocks by byte length instead of line-based filtering, to correctly handle commit messages beginning with M or D.
After rewrite, the final tree must byte-identically match the original tree after dynamic re-add, and all acceptance criteria must be verified before producing a success result.
The dry-run script must never push, must leave source remote branch and pre-heal tag refs unchanged, and must complete pack repack measurement within 150 MB ceiling.
